related.title: NuScale US600 模組設計研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程；NuScale US600 模組設計研究改以整合式壓水模組與共用水池為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment; NuScale US600 modular design study centers on integral pwr modules and a shared pool, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照壓力管與熱傳邊界與整合模組熱流體邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NuScale US600 模組設計研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生命週期更新證據為起點，設計一項能區分「壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程」與「整合式壓水模組與共用水池」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary with integral-module fluid boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NuScale US600 modular design study, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from lifecycle refurbishment evidence and propose an observation distinguishing pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment from integral pwr modules and a shared pool, including uncertainty.

related.title: Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程；Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程改以小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。

practice: 對照壓力管與熱傳邊界與小型BWR蒸汽邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生命週期更新證據為起點，設計一項能區分「壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程」與「小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary with small-bwr steam boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from lifecycle refurbishment evidence and propose an observation distinguishing pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment from small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構
history.text: Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構的公開資料展示壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture illustrate pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
